text_block_list.text:
Thanks for everything today, Trainer!<n>See ya
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I part ways with Taiki and start<n>walking back to my
place. But the<n>next moment...
Plip, plop...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It starts to rain. ...Unfortunately, I don't<n>have an
umbrella on me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I'd better hurry back...
Traineeer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Phew! Caught ya just in time!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I brought ya an umbrella! This oughta<n>keep ya dry!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whoops! Gosh, I'm such a<n>scatterbrain!
Hehe, all right! Let's head back<n>together!

Taiki brings me under her umbrella,<n>and we walk to
my place together.

Yay, we made it back safe and<n>sound! What a
relief!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hehe! You're welcome!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heh—guess buyin' that foldin'<n>umbrella ya showed
me was the right<n>choice!
I look at the umbrella propped up by<n>the entrance.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: It's the same one we bought together<n>at the mall.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Haha, I'm glad I got some use out of<n>it!
choice_data_list: I appreciate you helping me out.
You weren't so eager to buy it back then.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Haha, I'm glad I got some use out of<n>it!
choice_data_list: I appreciate you helping me out.
You weren't so eager to buy it back then.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, you betcha! Don't worry 'bout a<n>thing!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You're always workin' so hard for<n>my sake,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So that's why I wanna do whatever I<n>can to return
the favor!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, helpin' ya out today has made<n>me awful
happy! What a great day!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle shoots me a warm smile.
Haha... Sorry 'bout that.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Umbrellas sure are handy though.<n>Today's been a
real eye-opener.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I can't wait till it rains again!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If ya ever find yourself in a fix, I'll<n>come pick ya up,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle beams brightly as she<n>makes her
promise.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! Sayin' ya owe me a favor?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Haha, it's my lucky day! Well, you<n>can pay me
back next time it rains!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All ya gotta do is come and pick me<n>up. That all
right?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle shoots me a<n>mischievous grin.

text_block_list.name: タイキシャトル
text_block_list.text: ウェル～……気にしなくてもいいデスヨ～。

text_block_list.name: タイキシャトル
text_block_list.text: だってワタシ、いつもお世話になってマス！<n>だから2人の間に貸し借りはナシデス！

text_block_list.name: タイキシャトル
text_block_list.text: あ、でも――

text_block_list.name: タイキシャトル
text_block_list.text: どうしても貸しを返したいというのなら、<n>受け付けなくもアリマセン。

text_block_list.name: タイキシャトル
text_block_list.text: フフッ、そうですね～……では～……。

text_block_list.name: タイキシャトル
text_block_list.text: また今度、楽しいお出かけに行きマショウ？ それでチャラです♪
タイキシャトルは嬉しそうな表情で そうお願いしてきたのだった。
